subject: Support pipe2() on *BSD (#462)
reason: This is a portability refactor: it introduces a HAVE_PIPE2 macro so pipe2() is also used on OpenBSD/NetBSD/DragonFly. On Linux, where the fuzzer runs, HAVE_PIPE2 is defined exactly where the old __linux__ guard applied, so anetPipe() compiles to the identical code path on both the change and its parent — no behavior to compare or stress. The only differing paths are on *BSD platforms unreachable by this CI, and the pipe+fcntl fallback is unchanged. No scenario can distinguish the builds.
